parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the scaling group whose scaling configurations you want to query.

parameters.name: ScalingConfigurationName
parameters.description:
The name of scaling configuration N that you want to query.

The names of inactive scaling configurations are not displayed in the query results, and no error is reported.

parameters.name: ScalingGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the scaling group. You can query all scaling configurations in the scaling group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ess describe-scaling-configurations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --scaling-group-id asg-bp17pelvl720x3v70000 --scaling-configuration-id asc-bp17pelvl720x5ub0000 --scaling-configuration-name scalingcon0000 --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
